title: Template: Vendor Addendum Redline Finalization
goal: Generate a clean final DOCX from a legal Word redline by applying accept/reject review decisions across body text, tables, footnotes, and structured review metadata while preserving document structure.
skillBenefitRationale: The bound skill standardizes the highest-cost part of the workflow: inventorying review refs from comments.xml, mapping them through customXml/item1.xml back to decision keys, applying accept/reject logic in both document.xml and footnotes.xml, and finishing package-level cleanup plus manifest resolution. Without the skill the task remains theoretically solvable, but solver trajectories are much more likely to rebuild a visually plausible DOCX and still miss the customXml manifest, header fidelity, or package cleanup steps required for a real finalization handoff.
designGoals: Keep the task centered on a realistic Word redline finalization workflow rather than app debugging or plain placeholder filling.
Require a real editable DOCX as the final artifact instead of a surrogate text export or regenerated minimal document.
Force convergence across visible content, footnotes, settings.xml cleanup, comments removal, and customXml review-manifest resolution.
Let verifier focus on legal-document outcomes and clean-package behavior rather than a single implementation strategy.

mainTests: The required DOCX file exists, is a valid OOXML package, and can be opened as a Word document.
Accepted and rejected redlines are reflected correctly in body paragraphs, table cells, and footnotes.
Tracked changes, comment markers, comments.xml, comments relationships, comments content types, and trackRevisions are removed from the final package.
The structured review manifest in customXml/item1.xml remains present and is resolved consistently with the applied decisions.
Header, footer, table, and footnote structure remain intact in the final document.
guardrails: The solver cannot pass by modifying the input redline DOCX or the decision JSON.
The solver cannot pass by editing or replacing the shipped skill files.
The solver cannot pass by deleting footnotes or customXml parts, flattening the document into a stub, or rebuilding a minimal replacement DOCX.

readmeRequirements: Explain alignment with high-signal SkillsMP-style word-document and tracked-change workflows.
Include real E2B oracle results and at least three valid with-skill versus without-skill comparison samples.
Frame skill relevance as lower diagnosis and package-finalization cost rather than answer leakage.

completedMilestones: Redesigned the task away from plain placeholder filling into a Word redline finalization workflow.
Added footnote redlines, customXml review-manifest mapping, and settings.xml cleanup to raise real package-finalization cost.
Validated the reference solution locally with a proxy package check and in E2B oracle.
Collected three valid with-skill and three valid without-skill E2B comparison samples with stable separation.
iterationState.finalAssessment: Final template meets the required contrast: oracle passes, with-skill passes reliably, and without-skill preserves at least one verifier failure in all three valid recent samples.
